route.note: Enter and walk north into the junction
Left hallway to Dextren Ward; Bruegal may be on the way
Back to the right hallway: Kam Deepfury

pulls.note: Targorr alone or with one or two inmates.
Dextren Ward; pull him away from the other hallways because of the fear.
Hamhock, then Bazil Thredd in the neighbouring cells.

strategies.text: Thrash and an enrage at 20% health. Usually comes with one to three other prisoners: check for extras before the pull.
Intimidating Shout fears the group; pull him where the fear cannot carry you into other hallways. A Tremor Totem cancels it.
Shield Slam stuns the tank for 2 s and Improved Blocking spikes his block chance. Mostly a tank-focused fight.
Spams Chain Lightning and Bloodlusts himself (+30% speed, adds too). Stun him and slow attack speed (Thunderclap).
Dual-wielding hard hitter. Smoke Bomb stuns everyone nearby for 4 s and he then hits the next un-stunned player on threat, so ranged players stay back and move if targeted.

notes: Alliance only (inside Stormwind). OpenMap has no pins for this dungeon: Dextren Ward, Hamhock and Targorr are estimates from the three tinted rooms on the map picture; Kam Deepfury, Bazil Thredd and Bruegal Ironknuckle have no position (Method: Kam is in a chamber of the right hallway, Bazil is in the final chambers beyond Hamhock). Targorr can appear in several first-hallway chambers according to Method, so the tinted room is only one of them. NeedRoll's pins were used only as a cross-check; nothing was copied from them. Quest chain starts: The Unsent Letter from VanCleef (Deadmines) unlocks The Stockade Riots from Warden Thelwater, who stands inside the entrance.
